body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2005') -- <Visual News> Philips presents its wireless Audio System ‘Streamium’ at KES 2005, with which you can enjoy music anywhere in a house using Wi-Fi. The main body is equipped with 40 GB of HDD, which enables you to store maximum 750 pieces of CD, or convert them into mp3 files. You can use maximum 5 sub systems. It was awarded as ‘the best compact audio in Europe 2005~2006’ by EISA(European Imaging and Sound Association). It consists of main body and sub systems.
